messages.subject: Shiny apps based on MySQL data
parts:
Hi there, 

I've MySQL database in my laptop. I build few apps using data from that database. Locally apps are working but not when I deploy on shiny server.
This is the error: ERROR: Failed to connect to database: Error: Can't connect to local MySQL server through socket '/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock' (2)
 

I read many blogs but there is no straight forward answer. 

Is there any way to store my database in shiny server? 

I attached an example code. Any help would be appreciated. Thank you.

Regards,
Sadaf

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Shiny apps based on MySQL data
parts:
Hi Sadaf,
We tried to address some of those concepts in the user guide on docs.rstudio.com.
That being said, you will need to have your MySQL database hosted on a server that is accessible from the internet at large. You could run it on a hosted platform if you don't have the infrastructure to support it yourself. Amazon provides such a service (see RDS) but there are others out there as well.

Hope this helps.
Tareef
